findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice short questions for Unit 7 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 46 questions numbered 1-46; by section: 7.1 8, 7.2 9, 7.3 8, 7.4 8, 7.4.1 5, 7.4.2 8.

Short questions over every section 7.1-7.4.2 in book order: definitions and statements, factorial work, permutations with and without conditions, alike objects, circular arrangements, combinations, complementary combinations, diagonals and real-life counts. New numbers and situations throughout; no exercise question or book example is repeated. Book corrections followed. Every answer was checked by computation (formulas and brute-force listing in Python).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
